justification: The cone-construction defect is genuine and distinct from the ground-truth hyperbolic-decomposition defect. For q=2 over Q, put L0=Span(b1). The degree-one recursion gives ∂c_{b,L}=L−L0. A plane W has three lines, so ∂(W−c_{b,∂W})=3L0≠0: the proposed generator is not a cycle. In dimension five, the claimed cone identity also has the nonzero residual (3/4)d_V(L0), confirming the assessment’s counterexample.
